facts.fact: On 9 July 2019 Cabinet approved preparation of a new draft Site Specific Allocations DPD.
The proposed new DPD was intended to support the Havering Local Plan.
The proposed new DPD was intended eventually to replace the Romford Area Action Plan 2008 and Site Specific Allocations 2008.
Cabinet delegated finalisation of initial consultation documents to the Assistant Director of Planning.
Cabinet expected a Preferred Options document after initial consultation.
The consultation approach was described as robust and comprehensive.
Infrastructure was identified as a focal point for the council and developers.
The stated approach was to consider all sites, not only the largest schemes.
